== 56 x 20, layout a
  1 To-dos 4   2 Epics 6   3 All                 ◉ live |
    ╌ Keys ╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌    |
     j k        move (or up, down)                      |
     g G        top, bottom                             |
     Space      a page down; PgUp PgDn too              |
     ^d ^u      half a page down, up                    |
     Enter      open full screen                        |
     l          into an epic, or unfold it              |
     h Esc      back (h also folds)                     |
     Tab 1 2 3  switch tab                              |
     /          filter by title or id                   |
     y          copy id and title                       |
     Y          copy with details                       |
     x          done, or reopen                         |
     d          won't do, or delete a to-do             |
     s          snooze; 0 clears one                    |
     u          undo the last done, d or snooze         |
     j k scroll, any other key closes                   |
    ╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌    |
 any key close                                  1-18/21 |

== 56 x 30, layout a
  1 To-dos 4   2 Epics 6   3 All                 ◉ live |
    ╌ Keys ╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌    |
     j k        move (or up, down)                      |
     g G        top, bottom                             |
     Space      a page down; PgUp PgDn too              |
     ^d ^u      half a page down, up                    |
     Enter      open full screen                        |
     l          into an epic, or unfold it              |
     h Esc      back (h also folds)                     |
     Tab 1 2 3  switch tab                              |
     /          filter by title or id                   |
     y          copy id and title                       |
     Y          copy with details                       |
     x          done, or reopen                         |
     d          won't do, or delete a to-do             |
     s          snooze; 0 clears one                    |
     u          undo the last done, d or snooze         |
     o          show the item's app link                |
     p          this project, or every list             |
     r          refresh                                 |
     q          quit                                    |
                                                        |
      ✓         badge of your personal list             |
     GAR        badge of a project: its colour, its⋯    |
     ✦          a task an agent left for you            |
     ◦ ◒ ⊘      open, in progress, blocked              |
     ✓          done (green)                            |
     j k scroll, any other key closes                   |
    ╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌    |
